segments.title: conception and essential existence

spans.eng: Are nothing that can even exist

spans.tib: rtog pa yod pa kho nas yod pa nyid dang , rtog pa med par yod pa nyid med pa de dag ni
spans.eng: Things that can't even exist in the absence of conceptions

spans.tib: thag pa bsdogs pa la btags pa'i sbrul ltar
spans.eng: like a coil of rope you label with "snake."

spans.tib: rang gi ngo bos ma grub par nges so
spans.eng: absolutely things that cannot exist through any essence of their own

spans.tib: yang dag don ni rang gi ngo bos grub pa'o
spans.eng: The expression "reality" here refers to something that could exist through its own essence.

spans.tib: rtog pa ni de la bltos te skye ba'o
spans.eng: "Conception" is the fact that things occur through the process of conceptualization.

segments.note: PROVISIONAL machine alignment proposed independently by Codex (English-first). The commentary's positive-and-negative existence construction is retained as a complete depth-3 recast because GMR compresses its content into one English clause; no atom is invented for kho nas or yod nyid. The reordered rope comparison is explicit in eng_order. C16:808 has identical ACIP/Wylie but projection vocabulary in English and is not treated as an independent publication witness.
